$comment: Every named agent as an animated character in every theme's room (scripts/mockup-extract/characters.py). Codex draws each character's sheets from their station cut-out, so they wear what the room paints them in. 'height' is a standing character's height in room px; 'scale' adjusts one figure. Sheets: poses facing the viewer (front, front2), facing away (back), and walk cycles toward and away from the viewer. Each faces right; the app mirrors them for the left-hand directions.

front.facing: turned three-quarters toward the viewer and to the viewer's right (they face the lower right of the picture)
poses: standing relaxed, arms loosely at the sides
talking: one hand raised to chest height with the palm open, explaining, mouth open
listening: arms folded across the chest, head tilted slightly
thinking: one hand on the chin, eyes looking up
holding {mug} in both hands in front of the chest
reading a tablet held in both hands, looking down at it

front2.facing: turned three-quarters toward the viewer and to the viewer's right (they face the lower right of the picture)
poses: waving hello with one hand raised beside the head, smiling
presenting: one arm stretched out to the side pointing at something, the other hand relaxed
stretching: both arms raised above the head, back slightly arched
getting up out of a chair: knees bent, half standing, hands pushing off the knees (do not draw the chair)
standing with a closed folder held against the chest with both arms

back.facing: turned away from the viewer, three-quarters, toward the viewer's right (they face the upper right of the picture, so we see their back and the side of their face)
poses: standing relaxed, arms loosely at the sides
talking: one hand raised at shoulder height, gesturing
listening: arms folded across the chest
thinking: one hand on the chin
reaching forward with one hand raised to touch a screen at head height
holding {mug} in front of the chest

walkFront.facing: walking toward the lower right of the picture, turned three-quarters toward the viewer
poses: contact: left leg forward, heel touching the floor, right leg back, arms swinging opposite
down: weight on the left leg, knee slightly bent, right foot lifting
passing: standing on the left leg, right leg passing beside it, arms near the body
up: rising on the left leg, right leg swinging forward
contact: right leg forward, heel touching the floor, left leg back, arms swinging opposite
down: weight on the right leg, knee slightly bent, left foot lifting
passing: standing on the right leg, left leg passing beside it, arms near the body
up: rising on the right leg, left leg swinging forward

walkBack.facing: walking away from the viewer toward the upper right of the picture, turned three-quarters away (we see their back)
poses: contact: left leg forward, heel touching the floor, right leg back, arms swinging opposite
down: weight on the left leg, knee slightly bent, right foot lifting
passing: standing on the left leg, right leg passing beside it, arms near the body
up: rising on the left leg, right leg swinging forward
contact: right leg forward, heel touching the floor, left leg back, arms swinging opposite
down: weight on the right leg, knee slightly bent, left foot lifting
passing: standing on the right leg, left leg passing beside it, arms near the body
up: rising on the right leg, left leg swinging forward
